title: Metabolomics and Lipidomics Sample Preparation
author: Kevin Contrepois
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf4tjqwn

steps.title: Homogenize Frozen Tissues
steps.instruction: Homogenize roughly 30 mg of frozen tissues in 500 µl ice-cold methanol using bead beating (MP bioscience cat# 6913-100) at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Perform bead beating for 2 x 45 s

steps.title: Extract Lipids
steps.instruction: Combine 300 μl of the homogenate with 40 µL deuterated lipid internal standards (Sciex, cat#: 5040156, lot#: LPISTDKIT-101) and 1 ml of MTBE.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the organic and aqueous phases by adding ice-cold water and centrifuging.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 5 min at 20°C

steps.title: Precipitate Proteins from Phases
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins from both the aqueous and lipid phases using a solvent mixture spiked with internal standards.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μl of 33/33/33 acetone/acetonitrile/methanol spiked with 15 labeled metabolite internal standards to 300 μl of the aqueous phase and 200 μl of the lipid phase

steps.title: Process Metabolic Extracts
steps.instruction: Isolate and resuspend the metabolic extracts.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 17,000 g for 10 min at 4°C
Dry the metabolic extracts to completion under a stream of nitrogen

steps.title: Process Lipid Extracts
steps.instruction: Prepare the organic upper phase for storage.

substeps.instruction: Dry down 700 µl of the organic upper phase

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform final sample preparation on the day of analysis.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 300 μl of 10 mM ammonium acetate in 90/10 methanol/toluene
Centrifuge at 16,000 g for 5 min at 24°C
